title: Megurine Luka — Resonating Roughly But Richly〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay, here's to a successful event!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Congratulations♪
I'm glad your event went so well!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
We have Azusawa to thank for that.
Her performance set the pace for the rest of the event.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, you should've seen her. She was sooo awesome!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was totally mesmerized by her voice... I just sat there and watched her sing!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I was sure that you'd put on a wonderful performance, but it sounds like you did even better than I was expecting! Way to go, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, hehe... L-Luka, don't poke me like that... It tickles...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The pizza's ready, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Woohoo! Pizza!
MEIKO, can I cut it?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna use the rollie thing too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: My special pasta is also nearly done. Would someone mind carrying it over for me?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, I'll be right there.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, did you all hear that? Pizza and pasta! We have a big feast on our hands!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, only if you help out.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That means we'll need plates.
I'll go grab some now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh no! What can I help with...?
Only those who help out get to have this delicious pizza and pasta!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, maybe you could clear some space for the plates and such...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Nice idea! Thank you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. There's no need to thank me.
If anything, I should be thanking you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: After all, I was able to perform the way I did because of you two.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. You felt a strong connection to those you've been meeting around town...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. When I was on stage, I could clearly see how much they all supported me and were looking forward to seeing me perform.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: When that happened, my heart became filled with so much warmth... Which reminded me of what you said, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “I can guarantee that because we've been watching over all of you for so long now.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That was when I realized how I've had people supporting and watching over me this entire time. Right under my nose.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And how I want to show them my appreciation.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. When we sang together, I got this feeling that I could go higher and further...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Enough to reach the place you two took me to that time!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see. It's wonderful to hear that you understood how we felt.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But you're off by just a teensy-weensy bit.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, I am...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We didn't take you to that place, Kohane. All we did was stand next to you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
She's right.
You were the one who led us, no?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Which means you reached that place all by yourself, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: All by myself...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes.
And I suspect you felt that yourself if you did indeed unleash everything you had.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That may be why you were able to see everyone's faces so clearly.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You stood on stage and gave the audience an absolutely incredible performance...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You did, Kohane. No one else, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Yes, I did!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, you guys! Is there space on your table?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Because here comes the pizza!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And the pasta!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, hang on. We'll clear some space now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mmm! That smells delicious!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Alright, there's no time to waste!
Mouth-watering pizza and pasta awaits!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!
